title: Asking How: the Question Word Mivel

sections.content: mivel combines mi ('what') with the -val/-vel suffix, giving 'with what / by what means'. It's the natural question to ask before someone answers with a means of transport marked in -val/-vel.

items.english: How are we going? (by what means)

sections.content: Answer a mivel question with the same -val/-vel suffix used in the question: 'Mivel mész?' expects something like 'Busszal.', not just the bare noun 'busz'.
